name: Header
description: Site-wide page header with logo (text or image), primary navigation with optional active marking, an optional CTA button, and mega-menu dropdowns grouped into columns plus an optional featured teaser column (mega variant).
when_to_use: Exactly one Header per site, on the shared layout. Pick transparent when it sits over a Hero with imagery; mega when the navigation needs grouped second-level links.
capabilities: logo as text or uploaded image (svg/png/webp)
primary navigation with per-link active flag (active shows a brand-primary underline)
optional CTA button (cta_label + cta_to) — classic/transparent hide it, minimal/mega show it
mega-menu dropdowns: child links grouped into columns via a group heading
optional per-link featured teaser column in the mega panel (image + title + text)
transparent over-hero mode with light text

variants.description: White bar with bottom border. Default.
Transparent over the hero, light text — place directly above a Hero.
Nav links open mega-menu dropdowns built from links[].children (grouped columns).

breakpoints.mobile: Navigation collapses behind a burger; CTA stays visible where space allows.
breakpoints.desktop: Horizontal nav; mega-menu opens as a full-width panel.

ai.prompt_summary: Header: site header/navigation. Settings: variant (classic|transparent|minimal|mega), logo_text (fallback when no image), logo_image, cta_label, cta_to (CTA shows only in minimal/mega). Navigation in links[]: { label, to, active, children[] (mega variant): { group (column heading), label, to }, feature_title/feature_body/feature_image (optional mega teaser column) }.
ai.content_guidelines: 4-6 primary links with 1-2 word labels. One CTA at most (e.g. 'Kontakt'). Mega children: 2-3 groups with 3-5 links each; add a feature_title/feature_image to spotlight one topic.

field_hints.links.active: Marks the link as the current page (brand-primary underline).
field_hints.links.children: Only used by the mega variant; the group field clusters children into columns.
field_hints.links.feature_title: Optional mega-panel teaser column (with feature_image + feature_body); leave empty to omit.
field_hints.logo_text: Used when no logo_image is uploaded.
